text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I really did it! I got... 1st 
place, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Congratulations! That was a splendid run.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everything I've done up till now finally 
paid off, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In addition to normal training... 
thoroughly analyze race footage of the 
same course.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Doing what I can, to the best of my 
ability. I've steadily built it all up."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If you tackle it earnestly, step by 
step... you can overcome any wall, no 
matter how high.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll charge straight down this path in 
front of me! And I'll definitely seize the 
spotlight!
choice_data_list: You work harder than anyone else.
You're a harder worker than anyone else.

Let's train even harder so we can be the 
star!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll charge straight down this path in 
front of me! And I'll definitely seize the 
spotlight!
choice_data_list: You work harder than anyone else.
You're a harder worker than anyone else.

Let's train even harder so we can be the 
star!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe...! Hard work is all I really have 
going for me, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll work harder than anyone! That's the 
one thing—I'm totally confident in!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that case, starting tomorrow I'll 
double the weight training load and start 
morning practice an hour earlier—
choice_data_list: No, no, just don't push yourself too hard!

No, no, just don't push yourself too hard, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm sorry! I guess I got a bit too 
eager. ...Ehehe.
